English: Wooden Gateway
A rough, hastily constructed timber gateway with a crude palisade and watch post, suitable for frontier defense.
Guarded Portal
A reinforced wooden gate flanked by simple guard huts, allowing for more organized watch and control of passage.
Stone Gate
A sturdy stone gate replaces the old wood, with a small gatehouse atop, offering better protection and control.
Drawbridge Entry
A stone gatehouse with a wooden drawbridge spanning a defensive ditch or moat, increasing security and tactical options.
Portcullised Gatehouse
A formidable gatehouse equipped with a heavy iron portcullis and improved murder holes, providing superior defense.
Flanking Towers
Large stone towers flank the gatehouse, allowing defenders to enfilade attackers and greatly strengthen the gates security.
Murder Hole Passage
A fortified passage between double gates, lined with murder holes and arrow slits, offering devastating resistance to attackers.
Reinforced Gatehouse
A multi-storied, heavily buttressed gatehouse with layered defenses and fortified living quarters for elite guards.
Barbican Complex
A formidable outer barbican, with its own walls and towers, creating a deadly killing zone before the main gate.
Fortified Gate Bastion
An immense, state-of-the-art gate bastion with multiple layers of defense, garrisoned by seasoned troops and bristling with deadly defenses.
